'''Will Raiman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dagobah Regionals]] on 29 July 2000 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|Good Deck (There Is Good In Him)]], according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1070">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-31-iceman-s-dagobah-regional-report-2000d1070/ iceman-s-dagobah-regional-report-2000], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 31 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-31-iceman-s-dagobah-regional-report-2000d1070/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
